prompt_messages.content: Give a regex (Python) that matches ISO-8601 dates YYYY-MM-DD and rejects 2024-13-40. Mention the main edge case.

completion.content:
Regex cannot fully validate calendars, but this rejects impossible months/days:

```python
import re
ISO_DATE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:"
    r"(?:(?:19|20)\d{2})-"
    r"(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])|"
    r"(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\d|30)|"
    r"02-(?:0[1-9]|1\d|2[0-8]))"
    r"|(?:(?:19|20)(?:[02468][048]|[13579][26]))-02-29)"
    r"$"
)
```

Still pair with `datetime.date.fromisoformat` for leap-year edge cases if you need certainty.
